camel_example: aliyun agentidentity ListTokenVaults --region cn-hangzhou --NextToken AAAAAdDWBF2 --MaxResults 20 --version 2025-09-01 --method POST --force
description_en: Lists all API key credentials under the account
description_zh: 分页列出账户下所有的 API 密钥凭证
name: ListTokenVaults

parameters.help_en: The maximum number of results to return per page
parameters.name: max_results

parameters.help_en: The token used for pagination. You do not need to specify this parameter in the first call. In subsequent calls, pass the NextToken value returned in the previous response
parameters.help_zh: 用于翻页的 Token，首次调用时无需传入；后续调用透传上一次返回值中的 NextToken 即可
parameters.name: next_token

MaxResults.description_en: The maximum number of results to return per page

NextToken.description_en: The token used for pagination. You do not need to specify this parameter in the first call. In subsequent calls, pass the NextToken value returned in the previous response
NextToken.description_zh: 用于翻页的 Token，首次调用时无需传入；后续调用透传上一次返回值中的 NextToken 即可

RequestId.description_en: The unique identifier of the request

CreateTime.description_en: The creation time in UTC ISO 8601 format
CreateTime.description_zh: 创建时间，UTC ISO 8601 格式

EncryptionConfig.description_en: The encryption configuration of the token vault

KeyType.description_en: The type of the encryption key. Valid values: SERVICE_MANAGED_KEY (service-managed key) and CUSTOMER_MANAGED_KEY (customer-managed KMS key)
KeyType.description_zh: 加密密钥类型。取值：SERVICE_MANAGED_KEY（服务托管密钥）、CUSTOMER_MANAGED_KEY（用户自管 KMS 密钥）

KmsKeyArn.description_en: The ARN of the KMS key used when KeyType is set to CUSTOMER_MANAGED_KEY
KmsKeyArn.description_zh: 当 KeyType 为 CUSTOMER_MANAGED_KEY 时所使用的 KMS 密钥 ARN

RoleArn.description_en: The ARN of the RAM role used to authorize the AgentIdentity service to access other cloud resources such as KMS
RoleArn.description_zh: 用于授权 AgentIdentity 服务访问 KMS 等其他云资源的 RAM 角色 ARN

TokenVaultArn.description_en: The ARN of the token vault

TokenVaultName.description_en: The name of the token vault, which is unique under the current Alibaba Cloud account
TokenVaultName.description_zh: 凭证库的名称，在当前阿里云账号下唯一

UpdateTime.description_en: The update time in UTC ISO 8601 format
UpdateTime.description_zh: 更新时间，UTC ISO 8601 格式

TotalCount.description_en: The total number of entries that match the query conditions
TotalCount.description_zh: 查询条件下匹配的总条目数
